'''Spacesickness''' (alternatively spelled '''space sickness''') was a condition experienced by certain [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travelers. It caused nausea, and sometimes vomiting. Upon landing on [[Skye/Legends|Skye]] in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Halagad Ventor]] suffered a brief bout of space sickness.<ref name="Skyewalkers" />
